_readme: Single source for every /go/<slug> link. Edit here, run `npm run redirects`, never hand-edit public/_redirects. The bb-go Worker counts clicks, then serves these redirects. A slug is only linked from the site once its program status is 'approved' OR the page uses neutral wording (no affiliate claim). Owned/Tested/Researched wording is enforced in docs/RULES.md.
